definitions.gloss: constantly; always; at all times; permanently
definitions.explanation: Describes something that is continuously active, available, or in effect without interruption. Often used in technical, business, and institutional contexts.

examples.japanese: {常時|じょうじ}{接続|せつぞく}のインターネット。
このビルには{常時|じょうじ}{警備員|けいびいん}がいる。
examples.english: This building has security guards at all times.

examples.japanese: {店内|てんない}には{常時|じょうじ}100{種類|しゅるい}の{商品|しょうひん}を{取|と}り{揃|そろ}えております。
examples.english: We always have 100 varieties of products available in the store.

notes:
A formal adverb meaning 'at all times' or 'permanently.' Composed of {常|じょう} (constant) and {時|じ} (time). Used to describe systems, services, or states that are continuously maintained without interruption.

USAGE:
More formal and technical than いつも or {常|つね}に. Frequently used in business, IT, and institutional contexts: {常時|じょうじ}{接続|せつぞく} (always-on connection), {常時|じょうじ}{監視|かんし} (constant monitoring), {常時|じょうじ}{雇用|こよう} (permanent employment).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {常時|じょうじ}{接続|せつぞく} — always-on connection
- {常時|じょうじ}{監視|かんし} — constant monitoring
- {常時|じょうじ}{対応|たいおう} — available at all times
- {常時|じょうじ}{開放|かいほう} — permanently open

SIMILAR WORDS:
- いつも — always; the everyday casual word
- {常|つね}に — constantly, always; literary and emphatic
- {随時|ずいじ} — at any time, as needed; implies availability on demand rather than continuous operation
